## Install (fresh)

1. Download `handoff.exe` from this release.
2. Put it on PATH, or anywhere you keep portable tools. No installer.
3. Run `handoff new` from a terminal and share the printed URL with whoever is helping you.

The default relay is <https://handoff.whyknot.dev/>; set `HANDOFF_RELAY` to use another one. Full walkthrough: [README](https://github.com/{full-repo}#install).
